from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import numpy as np

data = load_breast_cancer()
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(data.data, data.target, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Single tree
dt = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42)
dt.fit(X_train, y_train)
print(f'Decision Tree: {dt.score(X_test, y_test):.3f}')

# Random forests
for n in [50, 100, 200]:
    rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=n, random_state=42)
    rf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    print(f'RF (n={n}): {rf.score(X_test, y_test):.3f}')

# Top 3 features from RF-200
top_idx = np.argsort(rf.feature_importances_)[::-1][:3]
for i in top_idx:
    print(f'{data.feature_names[i]}: {rf.feature_importances_[i]:.4f}')
